z-m-27-01.title: Zingaki izindlela zokunikeza amaswidi angu-6?
z-m-27-01.topic: Inani lezindlela zokunikeza amaswidi: ukuthi amaswidi ahlukaniswa yini nokuthi izandla ezingenalutho zivunyelwe yini
z-m-27-01.goal: Qaphela ukuthi umusho 'inani lezindlela zokunikeza' ngokwawo awunquli impendulo eyodwa, bese ubhala kabusha inkinga ngokusho wena izimo ezidingekayo ukunquma impendulo (ukuthi amaswidi ahlukaniswa yini, ukuthi izandla ezingenalutho zivunyelwe yini).
z-m-27-01.material: Sifuna ukunikeza wonke amaswidi angu-6 kubantu abathathu, 갑, 을, no-병. 갑, 을, no-병 banamagama amisiwe, ngakho bangabantu abahlukile. Izindlela zokunikeza amaswidi zibalwa ngomphumela othi 'ubani wathola ini.' Uma umphumela ufanayo, kuyindlela efanayo, futhi ukulandelana kokunikeza amaswidi akubalwa. Inkinga umusho owodwa nje. "Zingaki izindlela zokunikeza amaswidi angu-6 kubantu abathathu?"
z-m-27-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlulela ukuthi ulwazi luyanela yini ngaphambi kokuthola impendulo
z-m-27-01.thinking.1: Ukubikezela ukuthi inani lamacala liguquka kanjani uma izimo ziguquka
z-m-27-01.thinking.3: Ukubhala kabusha inkinga engacacile ukuze ibe nempendulo eyodwa
z-m-27-01.prereq.0: Ukubhala amacala njengamapheya ahlelwe nokuwalisitha ngaphandle kokushiya
z-m-27-01.prereq.1: Umthetho womkhiqizo nomthetho wesamba (izinga lengxenye yokuqala yeyunithi ethi 'ukubala amacala' kwi-High School Common Mathematics)
z-m-27-01.prereq.2: U-H2 ekwabiweni kwezinga lesikole ulebula nje yobunzima kuhlelo lokukhiqiza, hhayi ukwabiwa kwebanga lesikole. Cabanga ukuthi imiqondo eyisisekelo yeyunithi yokubala amacala isivele yafundwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze lo musho owodwa wodwa ube nempendulo eyodwa, yini enye okumele siyazi ngokuphelele? Khetha konke okufanele.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa, njengokudweba umugqa, izimo esezivele zibhalwe embhalweni wenkinga nezimo ezingabhalwanga.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.1: Lungisa inani eli-1 le-(갑, 을, 병) ukuze umphumela uhlale unjalo, bese ucabanga ukuthi yisiphi isimo, uma siguqulwa, esingenza lowo mphumela uhluke noma ungenzeki.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.a: Iminyaka yabantu abathathu 갑, 을, no-병
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.a: Iminyaka ayinakho ukuhlobana nenani lezindlela zokwehlukanisa. Cabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oluguqula indlela yokubala.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.b: Ukuthi amaswidi angu-6 ahlukaniswa komunye nomunye yini
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.b: Ubone ukuthi kuye ngokuthi amaswidi ahlukaniswa yini, ngisho nokusatshalaliswa okufanayo kwezinombolo kungabalwa njengezindlela ezihlukile.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi amaswidi anikezwa eyodwa ngesikhathi ngokushintshana noma wonke ngasikhathi sinye
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.c: Le nkinga isethwe ukubala umphumela kuphela hhayi ukulandelana kokunikeza. Sekuvele kuyisimo esilungisiwe.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi kulungile yini uma omunye wabantu abathathu engathola nhlobo iswidi
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.d: Ubone ukuthi ukuthi amacala lapho umuntu athola u-0 afakiwe yini kuguqula uhlu uqobo lwamacala angenzeka.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.e: Ukuthi 갑, 을, no-병 bangabantu abahlukile yini
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.e: Sekubhaliwe kakade ukuthi banamagama amisiwe. Hlukanisa ulwazi olunikeziwe nolwazi olushodayo.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.explain: Kunezingcezu ezimbili zolwazi olushodayo. Kuye ngokuthi amaswidi ahlukaniswa yini, ngisho noma izinombolo zifana, njengo-(갑 4, 을 1, 병 1), kuba yindlela ehlukile uma amaswidi atholwe ehlukile. Futhi, amacala angenzeka ayashintsha kuye ngokuthi isandla esingenalutho sivunyelwe yini. Ukuthi abantu bahlukaniswa nokuthi ukulandelana kokunikeza akubalwa sekunikeziwe kakade.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.prompt: Ake silungise icala lapho wonke amaswidi angu-6 enohlobo olufanayo futhi bonke abantu abathathu bathola okungenani e-1 ngamunye. Faka izindlela ezingu-6 ezihlukile. (inani elitholwa u-갑 ngu-a, elitholwa u-을 ngu-b, elitholwa u-병 ngu-c)
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokunquma inani elitholwa umuntu oyedwa, bese ubona ukuthi isamba samanani atholwa abanye abantu ababili kumele sibe yini.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.1: U-(4,1,1) no-(1,4,1) bayindlela efanayo? Hlola ngezinga lombhalo wenkinga lokuthi 'uma umphumela ufanayo, kuyindlela efanayo.'
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Bonke abantu abathathu banabo-1 noma ngaphezulu.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Bonke abantu abathathu kumele bathole okungenani e-1 ngamunye.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Amaswidi awakwazi ukwehlukaniswa, ngakho izinombolo ziyizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani lamaswidi kumele libe yinombolo ephelele.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Isamba samanani atholwa abantu abathathu kumele sibe ngu-6.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.explain: Ngaphansi kwalesi simo kunezindlela ezingu-10 ngokuphelele. U-(1,1,4), (1,4,1), no-(4,1,1) babalwa njengezindlela ezihlukile ngoba umuntu othola amaswidi angu-4 uhlukile. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abantu abathathu bahlukaniswa. Ngisho neqembu elifanayo lezinombolo (1,2,3) lihlukana libe yizindlela ezingu-6 kuye ngokuthi ubani othola amangaki.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu cabanga ukuthi amaswidi angu-6 wonke anamakha ahlukile, futhi kulungile uma umuntu engathola lutho. Uma kuqhathaniswa nokuhlukanisa amaswidi ohlobo olufanayo ngezandla ezingenalutho ezivunyelwe (izindlela ezingu-28), kwenzekani enanini lezindlela?
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha ukusatshalaliswa okukodwa kusuka ecaleni lohlobo olufanayo, u-(4,1,1), bese usebenza ngqo ukuthi leso sakhiwo sihlukana saba yizindlela ezingaki uma amaswidi ehlukaniswa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ngokunquma, iswidi ngeswidi, 'ngubani phakathi kwabantu abathathu athola lona,' bese ubala ukuthi leso sinqumo siphindwa kangaki.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.a: Kuyancipha. Ngoba amaswidi kumele ahlukaniswe, isimo siqine kakhulu.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.a: Ukuhlukanisa amaswidi akwenzi noma yikuphi ukusatshalaliswa okungenzeka kunyamalale. Bheka ukuthi ukusatshalaliswa okufanayo kwezinombolo kuhlukana kube yizindlela ezingaki.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.b: Kuyafana, izindlela ezingu-28. Ngoba inani lamaswidi nenani labantu kusala kunjalo.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.b: Noma izinombolo zamaswidi nabantu zifana, ekusatshalalisweni okufanayo u-(4,1,1) kuyindlela ehlukile uma ukuthi ubani othola amaswidi aliphi kuhlukile.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.c: Kuyanda. Ngoba ukusatshalaliswa okukodwa kuhlukana kube yizindlela eziningana.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.c: Ukhombile ukuthi uma amaswidi ehlukaniswa, ukusatshalaliswa okukodwa kuphuka kube yizindlela eziningana.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.d: Asikwazi ukwazi ngaphandle kokusebenza ukuthi kwenzekani.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.d: Ungaqhathanisa osayizi ngaphandle kokubala konke, ngokubheka ukusatshalaliswa okukodwa nokuthi kuhlukana kube yizindlela ezingaki.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.explain: Uma wonke amaswidi ehlukile, iswidi ngalinye likhetha oyedwa phakathi kwabantu abathathu, ngakho kungu-3 ku-6th power, okungukuthi, izindlela ezingu-729. Lokho kukhulu kakhulu kunezindlela ezingu-28 zohlobo olufanayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ngayinye yezingu-28 ihlukana ibe yizindlela eziningana. Isibonelo, ngisho no-(4,1,1) kuphela uhlukana abe iningi kuye ngokuthi amaswidi angu-4 awuthola u-갑 ayiwaphi.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.prompt: Buyekeza umusho wokuqala bese ubhala inkinga ngezincazelo ezimbili ezihlukile ukuze ngayinye ibe nempendulo eyodwa. Akudingeki uthole izimpendulo (izindlela ezingaki), kodwa ubhale ukuze kucace ukuthi yiziphi izimo owazengeza.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.0: Lungisa izingcezu ezimbili zolwazi olushodayo owazikhetha ekuqaleni, eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese uzifaka emshweni.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.1: Izincazelo ezimbili kumele zihluke okungenani esimweni esisodwa. Nquma ukuthi yisiphi isimo ozosishintsha bese usibhala.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ungasho emgqeni owodwa ukuthi yisiphi isimo esihlukile phakathi kwezincazelo ezimbili owazibhala?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Uma ufunda incazelo ngayinye, ungasho ukuthi amaswidi afana noma ahlukaniswe?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Encazelweni ngayinye, ungasho ukuthi kulungile yini uma umuntu engathola iswidi?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.0: Incazelo 1) Wonke amaswidi angu-6 ayohlobo olufanayo, futhi kulungile uma umuntu ethola u-0. Incazelo 2) Wonke amaswidi angu-6 anamakha ahlukile, futhi kulungile uma umuntu engathola lutho.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.1: Ingabhalwa njengenani lezindlela zokuhlukanisa amaswidi angu-6 afanayo ukuze bonke abantu abathathu bathole okungenani e-1 ngamunye, noma njengenani lezindlela zokuhlukanisa amaswidi angu-6 ahlukaniswayo ukuze akho muntu oshiyiwe.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Le mpendulo ikhethe ukuhlanganisa kwesithathu kwezimo (ahlukaniswa + wonke athola e-1 noma ngaphezulu). Noma ukuhlanganisa kuhlukile, kuvumelekile inqobo nje uma izimo zicacile.
